find: Male condoms are the only contraceptive method that also protects against sexually transmitted infections (STIs). All other methods prevent pregnancy but do not provide protection against STIs.
replace: Male and female condoms are the only contraceptive methods that also protect against sexually transmitted infections (STIs). Other methods prevent pregnancy but do not provide protection against STIs.
note: F1: Internal (female) condoms also reduce STI risk.

expect: Which is the only contraceptive method that protects against STIs?
value: Which contraceptive methods protect against STIs?
note: F2: The question falsely excludes internal condoms.
F2: Both external and internal condoms reduce STI risk.

find: Financial and employment preparations are also important: statutory maternity pay in the UK begins at 26 weeks pregnant, and parents should notify employers and understand entitlements to shared parental leave well in advance.
replace: Financial and employment preparations are also important: parents should notify employers and understand their leave and pay entitlements well in advance.
note: F3: Statutory Maternity Pay normally starts when maternity leave starts.

expect: One mark each for: forceps delivery [1]; ventouse (vacuum extraction) [1]. (Caesarean section is a surgical delivery, not an assisted vaginal delivery — do not credit as a third option here.) [2 marks]
value: One mark each for any two from: forceps delivery / ventouse (vacuum extraction) / episiotomy / elective or emergency caesarean section. [2 marks]
note: F4: The specification includes all four under methods of assisted birth.

find: Car seats should never be placed in the front passenger seat if there is an active airbag fitted.
replace: A rear-facing car seat should never be placed in the front passenger seat if there is an active airbag fitted.
note: F5: The front-airbag restriction applies to rear-facing baby seats.
